positions.name: RememberAsyncContract
positions.frame: how does the remember operation's async job contract coordinate dispatch, receipt, polling, and lost-work prevention?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under one directional read of the async job contract for remember: src-1 ratifies the contract terms (immediate receipt, cursor-pollled extraction watching), src-2 asserts the no-blocking and no-lost-work guarantees, and src-3 records the key decision that dispatch is followed by either polling or piggybacked reaction on a later call. Together they span the full contract shape — dispatch, immediate return, polling cursor, piggybacked reaction, and lost-work prevention — with no internal tension; each fills in a different facet of the same contract.
